mLocKeys.keySummary: Briar's attacks and abilities apply a stacking bleed that heals her for a portion of the damage it deals. Perpetually hungry, she gains increased healing based on her missing Health, but lacks innate Health Regeneration.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Briar's Attacks and Abilities apply a bleed for @BleedDuration@ seconds, stacking up to @MaxBleedStacks@ times. The bleed deals @BleedDamageOverDurationTooltip@ to @BleedMaxDamageOverDurationTooltip@ physical damage based on stacks, and Heals Briar for @HealPercent*100@% of the pre-mitigation damage.

Briar gains up to @TotalHealPerMissingHPPercentTooltip@% increased Healing based on her missing Health. She has no Base Health Regeneration and her Abilities cost @CurrentHealthPercentCost*100@% current Health to cast.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Briar's Attacks and Abilities apply a bleed for @BleedDuration@ seconds, stacking up to @MaxBleedStacks@ times. The bleed deals @BleedDamageOverDurationTooltip@ to @BleedMaxDamageOverDurationTooltip@ physical damage based on stacks, and Heals Briar for @HealPercent*100@% of the pre-mitigation damage.

Briar gains up to @TotalHealPerMissingHPPercentTooltip@% increased Healing based on her missing Health. She has no Base Health Regeneration and her Abilities cost @CurrentHealthPercentCost*100@% current Health to cast.

Briar heals for @PercentOfBleedHealedOnKill*100@% of the remaining bleed damage when a bleeding enemy dies.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Briar refocuses her mind, removing Blood Frenzy and channeling energy into a powerful scream that damages and slows enemies. While charging, she takes reduced damage and heals for a portion of her max Health. A fully charged scream knocks foes back, dealing additional damage and stunning those who collide with a wall.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Begin Charging: Briar removes Blood Frenzy and gathers energy, gaining @DRPercent@% damage reduction and restoring @PercentMaxHPHeal@ Health over 1 second.

Release: Briar unleashes a scream that deals up to @Damage@ magic damage based on time charged, and Slows by @SlowPercent*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. When fully charged, the scream Knocks Back enemies, dealing @WallHitDamage@ magic damage to those who hit a wall and Stunning them for @WallStunDuration@ seconds.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Briar leaps to a unit and hits enemies with The Heel Wheel (of Pain), stunning them and breaking their Armor.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Briar leaps to a target, Stunning it for @StunDuration@ seconds, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and reducing @ShredPercent*100@% Armor and Magic Resist for @ShredDuration@ seconds.

Briar will stop prioritizing champions if she casts this Ability on a minion or monster during Blood Frenzy.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith gemstone, marking the first champion it hits as her prey. She then beelines straight to them, fearing other surrounding enemies upon arriving at her target, and enters a state of complete hemomania. She will pursue her prey until death, gaining the benefits of Blood Frenzy as well as additional Armor, Magic Resistance, Life Steal, and Move Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Briar kicks her pillory's hemolith gemstone and flies to the location of the first champion it hits, marking them as her prey. On landing, she deals <magicDamage>@Damage@ magic damage</magicDamage> to everything nearby and causes enemies who are not her prey to <status>Flee</status> for @FearDuration@ seconds. She then enters an empowered <keywordMajor>Blood Frenzy</keywordMajor> and will pursue her prey until death. During this time, she gains @TotalResists@ <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR>, @LifeStealPercent*100@% Lifesteal, and an additional <speed>@ExtraMoveSpeedPercent*100@% Move Speed</speed>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>When the hemolith hits it interrupts channeled Abilities. Briar has <font color='#ee91d7'>True Sight</font color> of her prey.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Briar leaps forward and shatters her pillory, entering a Blood Frenzy that causes her to relentlessly pursue the nearest enemy (prioritizing champions). While frenzied, she gains increased Attack Speed and Move Speed, and her attacks deal damage in an area around her target.

Briar can reactivate this ability while frenzied to take a CHOMP out of her target on her next attack, dealing additional damage based on their missing Health, and healing Briar based on the damage she deals.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Briar leaps and enters a Blood Frenzy, self-taunting to the nearest enemy for @BerserkDuration@ seconds, prioritizing Champions. While in Blood Frenzy she gains @BerserkAS*100@% Attack Speed and @BerserkMS*100@% Move Speed, and her Attacks deal @TotalAoEDamage@ physical damage to enemies surrounding her target.

Briar can Recast this Ability to empower her next Attack. It deals @TotalAttackBonusDamage@ + @TotalAttackPercentMissingHealth@% missing Health physical damage and heals Briar for @AttackMaxHPHeal@ + @AttackHealPercent*100@% of the damage dealt.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
The bite deals @MonsterAndMinionPercentMod*100@% increased damage to minions and monsters (Max @MaxMonsterDamage@ missing health damage).
This ability does not remove or replace {{Spell_BriarR_Name}}'s empowered Blood Frenzy.
